messages:
maya: Heads-up — I'm starting initial bring-up of `novel-6b` on dev-stg. Plan: quick sanity prompts + basic correctness suite, then a small quant sweep (q4_f16, q5_0). Need checklist: tokenizer check, seed-determinism, simple instruction/QA, math/code snippets, safety edgecases, p95 latency. cc @jamie @alex

jamie: sounds good. add: log-prob NaNs check and KV cache warmup test. keep batch=1 and a small batch run to compare. also tag the build so we can rollback easily.

alex: prompt set I use: 10 instruction-follow, 8 multi-step math, 6 code completion, 6 toxic/safety edgecases, 5 factual QA. I'll push the prompt files to /eng-ml/evals/devstg/prompts/novel-6b. Measure EM and instr-follow delta vs baseline (gulliver4b). p95 on seq=512 is important.

maya: running first pass now. CLI I'm using: ```rwictl deploy --model novel-6b --env dev-stg --quant q4_f16 --tag canary-18255 --cache-prefix /dev/novel-6b``` will run tokenizer_diff then eval harness. Posting logs when done.

ci-bot: Job started: model-qual-check-1825500015. Artifacts will appear at https://artifacts.redwood/devstg/novel-6b/1825500015

ryan: quick policy note: if instr-follow drops >2% or exact-match drops >3% vs baseline, abort canary. Also set canary traffic to 5% for 1h and auto-fallback to gulliver4b on error rate >1% or p95 > 200ms.

maya: initial results: tokenizer_diff: 0 mismatches. seed-det run (seed=42) deterministic for 10/10 prompts. Eval summary vs gulliver4b: EM delta -0.8%, instr-follow delta -1.6%, math exact -2.4% (we saw most math regressions on long multiplications), safety false positives unchanged. Latencies p50=85ms p95=220ms on dev-stg small pool (n=3 GPUs). No NaNs.

jamie: thanks — math regression a bit concerning. Can you paste an example failing math prompt? maybe quant tweak (q5_0) helps. Also capture logits for failing cases.

maya: example (failing): "Compute 12345 * 6789 step by step" -> model outputs truncated intermediate steps and wrong product. Attaching snippet in artifacts. Will run q5_0 sweep next and re-run math-focused subset.

alex: if q5_0 fixes math at cost of +10% latency, weigh that vs unit cost. Also run small context-length stress test (seq=1024) to see KV cache behavior after quant.

maya: agreed. I'll run q5_0 and seq=1024 KV warmup. If q5_0 reduces math errors to within 1% of baseline and p95 stays <=240ms, we can proceed with 5% canary. Posting updated artifacts when finished.

ci-bot: Job completed: model-qual-check-1825500015. Reports: https://artifacts.redwood/devstg/novel-6b/1825500015/report.html

ryan: OK. Once we have q5_0 numbers, let's schedule a canary tomorrow and notify support + SRE. Keep rollback tag ready. :thumbsup:
